text:
Maria: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem on the LB edge behavior. We surfaced a recurring 'retry storm' when connection resets happen during TLS renegotiation across regions. Putting owners and timeline here for tracking.

Derek: Thanks. My quick summary: when upstream health checks hit a transient 502 + client retry, we see per-route backlog growth and some cross-region probes trigger full-route re-eval.

Ashwin: Adding the runtime signalization folks. Possible root: health-check probe timeout + connection pool eviction. I can reproduce with this curl loop:

```
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -D - -o /dev/null "https://edge.redwood.test/api/health?probe=$i" &
done
```

Derek: Confirmed. Logs show repeated TLS alerts then LB rebinds. Excerpt:

```
EDGE-1 2026-03-12T22:14:05Z ALERT: tls_alert(40) conn_id=0x1fa
EDGE-2 2026-03-12T22:14:06Z ROUTE: re-eval route_id=us-west -> us-east
```

Gina: From product: customers are seeing spikes in tail latency during these windows. Prioritizing remediation.

Maria: Action items I propose:
- A1 assign: Derek to own diagnostic playbook and quick mitigation (48h)
- A2 assign: Ashwin to test runtime pool eviction fixes + config guardrail (1 week)
- A3 assign: Kevin to add alert rule for 'edge TLS disconnect rate > 0.5% over 5m' and onboarding runbook (3 days)
- A4 assign: Gina to coordinate customer comms and PBPs (5 days)

Derek: Accepting A1. I'll push a mitigation toggle to disable per-route rebind on transient TLS alerts and open PR: infra/edge#842.

Ashwin: For A2 I'll try bumping keepalive and changing pool LRU to prefer active connections; will run canary in eu-central.

Kevin: Adding the alert now. Rule: sum(rate(edge_tls_disconnects[5m]))/sum(rate(edge_connections[5m])) > 0.005 -> pager to eng-sre.

sre-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-218 for 'edge tls disconnect retry storm' assigned to Derek, Ashwin, Kevin. Linked postmortem: PM-2026-38

Maria: Timeline check — can we commit mitigation toggle today and have alert live by EOD tomorrow?

Derek: I can ship the toggle in ~6h, will coordinate with eng-oncall for rollout window 23:00 UTC.

Ashwin: Canary results look good so far (30m). No increased error surface. I'll prepare config patch for 1-week rollout.

Gina: I'll draft a short customer note and flag any enterprise customers for a follow-up.

Kevin: Alert is in place in staging, will promote to prod after Derek's toggle is live.

Derek: PR merged, rollout started 23:10 UTC, toggled rebind=false for transient tls_alerts. Observability dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/d/edge/retries

Maria: Monitoring — initial metric drop confirmed. Re-assigning owners for long-term: Ashwin -> runtime fix, Derek -> LB policy hardening, Kevin -> alerting, Maria -> 2-week postmortem cleanup. Closing check-in in 14 days.

Derek: Optional follow-up — propose we run a 48h automated probe across regions to catch regressions. I'll add to INC-2026-218.

sre-bot: Reminder set: 14d check-in for INC-2026-218 scheduled.

Maria: Thanks everyone. If you hit blockers, ping here. :thumbsup:
